venture.name: Sightlines
venture.one_liner: Disability-awareness training for employers, designed and delivered by people who are losing their sight.
venture.problem_statement: Young adults newly diagnosed with sight loss in Singapore lose their footing at work at exactly the moment employers are least equipped to keep them. Sightlines turns that lived experience into training the employer pays for, delivered by the people it is about.
